Native CPU pure-waveform audio program. A decoded/resampled mono branch is normalized; another independently rescales raw samples. Named outputs preserve both branches. Right padding uses an authored nonzero fill and publishes its validity mask and valid sample count. A real ONNX mean head consumes the padded normalized waveform. Eight samples and all other dimensions are fixture data, not runtime assumptions. This verifies dataflow, not speech-recognition quality.
